state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`: stage 5 (Install and Guides) is in progress. Install, the Tour and Why people pick Novis are done, and `--check guides` is written.**

Install has four pages under `install/`, snippets under `website/snippets/install/`. Novis has no release yet, so the install page builds from source.

The Tour is `guides/tour/index.mdx` and ten steps, `01-methods-and-types.mdx` to `10-web-app.mdx`. Each step ends with a "Next:" link. Novis has no free functions (`E0215`), so every snippet uses a class. A compile error or `nvs test` output is shown as a `txt` block copied from a real run.

Why people pick Novis is `guides/why-novis/index.mdx` and 11 candidate pages, grouped on the index as Safety, Language design and Simplicity, each with a snippet under `website/snippets/guides/why-novis/` and a link into Syntax or Reference. It is in the sidebar before the Tour. The user curates the final list when the goal lands. A complete-`match` page was dropped: a `match` on an enum with a missing arm compiles and throws `LogicError` at run time, so "exhaustive match" is not a claim Novis can make.

`--check guides` (`guidesProblems` in `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts`) fails now only on the six sections not written yet. `site structure`, `stale`, `reference`, `syntax` and `--build` pass. `snippets` and `prose` fail only on `index.mdx`, `sponsoring.mdx` and `in-depth/what-changed.mdx`, which stage 6 rewrites. `apps` and `in-depth` are stubs (`LATER` in `site.ts`).

A page whose `covers:` names a feature id needs `bun nv site --stamp <page>` before `--check stale` passes.

items.text: **Simple programs**: `guides/simple-programs/index.mdx` and six one-file programs (CSV report, JSON API, file watcher, scraper, form handler, scheduled job), each one snippet with its output and a short walk-through. A program that needs a capability gets an `nvs.toml` beside it, and one that answers a request gets a `.nvsr`. Add the group to the sidebar after the Tour. Specified by `docs/agent/goals/side/website-overhaul.md` § Stage 5. Anchors: `website/astro.config.ts:139`, `tools/nv/cmd/site.ts:563`
**Cookbook**: `guides/cookbook/` with ten task pages, one snippet each. Specified by the same section. Anchors: `website/astro.config.ts:139`

**How to use Novis, Testing your app, Going to production**: the three prose sections, each with a Do / Don't list where the goal names one. Specified by the same section. Anchors: `website/astro.config.ts:139`
